name: Jael's Missile Weapons
desc1: This small, but well-kept shop has that newly-opened look to it, with
desc2: everything in order and in pristine condition. Ranged weapons of all
desc3: descriptions hang from the walls or are displayed in cases, and a
desc4: carefully-scripted sign on the wall lists the wares available. The
desc5: only visible exit is through the entrance to the west.
